facts.text: Tonight I found us cold beers and a proper dinner. Forty years inside teaches you to eat a good meal slowly.
facts.why: Red doesn't say this and doesn't get the beers. Andy talks Hadley into the beers for the tarring crew in exchange for tax advice, and Red is one of the men on the roof. The note makes Red the provider.
facts.fix: Andy got us a cold beer each on the roof. For an hour we felt like free men. Make it last.

facts.text: Pour the beers when the tarring crew gets their cold ones on the roof.
facts.why: In 1949 Andy helps Hadley with his inheritance tax and asks for cold beers for the crew working on the roof. Matches.

vibe.verdict: A clean mess hall tray with the rooftop beers, Brooks and Jake and Zihuatanejo all in, but the food names are mostly cute and the note is off.
